shots.focal_element: Floating 'AI Agents' UI card composited top-left over a wide office shot of the two seated colleagues
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans (low-confidence guess: a Grotesk-style UI face); card title in bold sentence case with a sparkle icon, task row in regular weight sentence case, normal tracking
shots.what_happens: Locked-off wide shot of the woman and man at their desk while the man speaks (w363-w376, 'automatically collect time off requests ... I'll set guardrail'); a frosted translucent card with a green header 'AI Agents' sits upper-left, its inner row starts as a blank placeholder, then shows 'Collecting time off requests' with a spinner ring that resolves into a check mark.
shots.build_rebuild: Over live-action footage, composite a rounded frosted-glass card with a green gradient header 'AI Agents' and a white inner pill whose blank placeholder resolves to a task label, then animate a circular spinner that morphs into a check mark about one second later.

shots.focal_element: Medium two-shot of the woman (left third) and the man (right), the man talking
shots.what_happens: Tighter medium two-shot; the man finishes the guardrail line (w377-w387, 'so no one's on vacay for months out of time Nick') while the woman reacts; no UI overlay in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a static medium two-shot with soft background office lights and play the dialogue line with no overlay, letting the performance carry the beat.

shots.focal_element: Profile two-shot of the pair framed through a blurred foreground monitor arm
shots.what_happens: Short side-angle shot with heavy foreground bokeh (monitor and lamp out of focus) as the man starts 'and my gaggle of agents' (w388-w392); no overlay.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a roughly 1.2 s side-angle cutaway shot at shallow depth of field with a defocused foreground object framing the subjects, no graphics.

shots.focal_element: Wide shot of the pair at the desk with a large monitor showing a schedule/Gantt-like view on the right
shots.what_happens: Return to the wide office master shot (same setup as s058, no overlay this time) while the man says 'plan our team's capacity and work with' (w393-w400); the on-screen monitor shows a planning UI but it is too small to read.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut back to the wide master with deep office perspective and a practical monitor showing a planning timeline, keeping the composited card off so the next overlay reads as a new beat.

shots.focal_element: Profile two-shot through the blurred foreground monitor (repeat of the s060 angle)
shots.what_happens: Repeat of the side angle with foreground bokeh while the man continues 'your agents to balance PTO' (w401-w405); no overlay is visible within the shot (the green card visible in the last sheet frame appears to belong to the next shot's setup).
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the shallow-focus side-angle cutaway for about 1.5 s as a rhythm cut between the wide master and the close-up overlay shot.

shots.focal_element: Floating 'AI Agents' approval card at upper right next to the man's head in a close two-shot
shots.typography: Same geometric sans UI style as s058; bold sentence-case card title with sparkle icon, regular-weight bullet text wrapping onto two lines, and a small bold label inside a green pill button
shots.what_happens: Closer two-shot in a different room: the man talks ('customer service coverage for our approval', w407-w412) while the woman gives a skeptical side-eye; the frosted 'AI Agents' card at upper right types on 'Send notification to client' and then a green 'Approve' pill appears, tying the human-in-the-loop approval to the dialogue.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a frosted card with green header in the upper-right negative space, typewriter-reveal a bullet task line, then pop in a green pill 'Approve' button about 0.5 s later, synced to the spoken word 'approval'.
